services.desc: Mediterranean climates are marked by warm (even hot) dry summers and mild wet winters, with about 24 inches of rain yearly. They can be found in the lower middle latitudes of every continent, often on the west coasts. Ecosystems in this climate are typically located near large bodies of water, appropriate since the name is from the Mediterranean Sea, “between the lands” of Europe and Africa. A great variety of native plants grow in these ecosystems, those that have adapted to summer drought and are resilient enough to come back after both fires and floods.
